title: LTX prompt review
description: episodes/<slug>/<EPID>/_context/ltx-prompt-review.json — the validator's verdict per clip. Written draft at 04f (mode: draft) and strict at 04f3 (mode: strict). Only a strict review with status PASS clears the 04f3 completion gate; 04g refuses to build a render package from a review containing any FAIL.

mode.description: draft: run only the checks the inputs on disk allow, may PASS with gaps. strict (04f3): every clip must have a blocking.json entry, a frame0-requirements block and a still, or the run FAILs.

source_prompts_sha256.description: Hash of prompts/7-video-prompts.md, the file the review actually read. A review is stale the moment that file changes.

source_manifest_sha256.description: LEGACY (written until 2026-10-29). Despite the name it hashed ltx-prompt-manifest.json only if that file already existed, otherwise prompts/7-video-prompts.md -- which at 04f3 it never did. Read-only compatibility; new reviews write source_prompts_sha256.

validator_sha256.description: Hash of tools/ltx_prompt_validator.py at review time. A changed validator invalidates a stored verdict — a review is only meaningful against the rules that produced it.

rule_catalog_sha256.description: Hash of pipeline/ltx_prompt_validator.md, so catalog drift is visible too.

strict_input_gaps.description: clip id -> list of missing inputs. Empty in a clean strict run; in a draft run it records what was skipped rather than failed.

checked_rule_ids.description: Rules whose check actually ran for this clip given the inputs on disk. A rule that was never checked is not a rule that passed — see skipped_rule_ids.

skipped_rule_ids.description: Rules that could NOT be checked for want of an input (no blocking.json, no frame0-requirements block, no still, no voice-signatures.json, no spoken_word_band). checked + skipped covers every implemented rule.

input_gaps.description: Which per-clip inputs are missing. In strict mode a non-empty list FAILs the clip.

warnings.description: Recorded, never silently cleared. Warnings mostly carry [C] 2.3-retest house limits rather than vendor facts.

conformance_read.description: The global ltx25-prompting skill's read-only pass, run last. It never drafts or rewrites; where it disagrees with LTX_I2V_CONTRACT.md the contract wins and the disagreement is recorded here rather than acted on.
